title: vars message (REMOVED / deprecated)
description: DEPRECATED. Describes the REMOVED `vars` message purely so the orphan fixture protocol/fixtures/vars_mixed.json still maps to a schema and the gate stays strict. The backend no longer emits this; per review 10 finding 9 and adoption-map item 4, vars_mixed.json should be RETIRED. This schema exists to route the orphan, not to bless it. It also illustrates a subset limit: the `items` array is heterogeneous by `kind` (image vs scalar), which without oneOf can only be modelled as a permissive union (name+kind required, everything else optional) — see the heterogeneous-array finding.

value.description: Inline value for non-image kinds; type varies by kind, so left unconstrained (any) — a subset consequence of no per-kind discrimination.
